note: Music room of the conjunctions (cartoon style): lilac-grey walls, pale grey floor, rainbow ribbon maypole (landmark), upright piano under a cuckoo clock. et (pony eats hay and a carrot), mais (maypole dancer), comme (girl combs her hair like the cat licks its paw), que (cuckoo louder than the piano), ou (two cakes: this or that?), quand (tin-can telephone), ni (bandaged knee), car (toy car), pourtant (poor busker smiling anyway), sinon (cookie jar held up: tidy up, or else). Conjunctions have no gender (divider null). Lilac door back to the cloud playroom (left), staircase up to the attic (right), pupil's desk zoom in the middle.
